p.src: 1  The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

en: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
u.src: 1  The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

p.src: 2  He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

en: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
u.src: 2  He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

p.src: 3  He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

en: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
u.src: 3  He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

p.src: 4  Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

en: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
u.src: 4  Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

p.src: 5  You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

en: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
u.src: 5  You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

p.src: 6  Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

en: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.
u.src: 6  Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.
